column1: # Kegare, a demon from another age who has taken Mia's visage.

column3:
You all turn to Mia
when someone is hurt.
I've watched that.{page_break}I could make them
turn to me instead.{end_wait}
You have her face.\nBut you're not Mia.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

Kegare. I've waited
through an age
long buried.{page_break}I learned her voice.
I copied her face.
Now I'll take her place.{end_wait}
You can look like her.\nShe is still here.\nWe know who she is.{end_wait}
You learned my face.\nDid you learn the names\nof those I cared for?{end_wait}
They'll hear my voice\nand call me Mia.\nYou'll be forgotten.{end_wait}
In Imil, I stayed\nwhen they were sick.\nYou can't undo that.{end_wait}
